Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh... my... gosh! I can't believe it! We're finally going to have our first... (with Stacy) Spa day! Algae infused seaweed mud wrap...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hot rock rub and volcanic mineral scrub!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (surprised) Fun?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Mud, seaweed, volcanic rock.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not fun, it's relaxing. Which means it's enjoyable, which means it's fun. Grown-up fun. You wouldn't understand. Besides, Le Rub de Scrub Spa is very exclusive. You can't even get in unless you know someone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are you guys getting in?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I know Stacy...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: ...and I know this neighbor who knows this hair-washer, who knows this bank teller, who knows this back-waxer who works at the spa.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and I know Stacy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Well Ferb and I just aren't connected like you guys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on. Let's get going. (she and Stacy walk away)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, guys. Where ya goooin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're going to the spa.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah. We're gonna get totally immersed in self-indulgence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And mud.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sounds like fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See? I told you it was fun.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I think we're going to build a spa. (to Ferb) What do you say, Ferb? It'll give you a chance to do your seaweed rap. You know... (imitating turntable scratches) Hyah!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (blinks then rolls his eyes; pause) Okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bills, bills, bills. Ooh, half off at Slushy Burger. Keepers...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Aw, what a little cutie. What's a cute little love bug like you doing out here all by yourself? I'll call you Mr. Fluffy Pants because you're fluffy and you look like you're wearing pants. Plus, you remind me of my uncle Fluffy Pants.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So what do you think? Soak, steam, sauna then shower? Or shower, steam, soak then sauna?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Yumemy. Uh, uh, I mean...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm on my way to build houses for charity. You girls want to come with?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, we can't because we're going to the... (Candace quickly elbows her) Ow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, wow, philanthropy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But what about the... (Candace elbows her again; she falls to the ground) Ow!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, it's okay, Candace, if you guys are too busy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, what was that all about?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, please hold. (to Stacy) Look, I don't want him knowing about the whole spa thing. He'll think all I care about is myself.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uno momento, por favor. (to Stacy) Look, we'll go "help people" for, like, 15 minutes and then we'll go to the spa.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your call is very important to us and will be answered in the order received. (to Stacy) We'll still be able to make it to our spa day.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, if you'd rather have a spa day...

Name: Candace
Dialog: You heard spa day? Because I said, "Hurrah day". Like, "Hurrah, I can't wait to build houses." That's what we're doing, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Salt scrub. Nice, nice. Milk bath. Good. Hey, where's Buford with the seaweed?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, the volcanic rock is here.

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: Yeah, you're going to want to let this cool down a bit before you use it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, he's such a cute little kitty. That's right. That's right. He wuvs his tuna fish. Yes, you eat that and I'll be over here working on my latest project. (pushes a button; chuckles) I'm painting.

Name: Mr. Fluffy Pants
Dialog: (Meows)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, I see you found my blueprints.

Name: Mr. Fluffy Pants
Dialog: (Purrs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You like those? You like...? (the little kitty proceeds to start shredding the blueprints) No! Not my blueprints! (beeping) No!

Name: Mr. Fluffy Pants
Dialog: (Jumps up and down on the controller.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! What-What are you doing? I worked all... (blubbering) Not the Gloom-inator! No, no! Get off, get off!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Wow. I hope it doesn't rain on us. (sighs) Anyway, I want to thank you all for volunteering today. Now, if I could have you two on drywall duty. And, you, you're on baseboard duty. (to Jeremy) And I could use you on conduit duty.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, sorry, girls. I've got you two earmarked for nail duty.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Woman
Dialog: And that doesn't mean manicures.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: Aw.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Heh, don't worry, Ferb. Your secret's safe with me. Don't we have one more truck coming?

Name: Delivery Man 2
Dialog: Excuse me, we have a delivery for Phineas Flynn.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's me.

Name: Delivery Man 2
Dialog: We've got 18 cases of cucumbers right here. (camera pans to the aforesaid cases)

Name: Delivery Man 3
Dialog: Say, aren't you a little young to order all this?

Name: Delivery Man 2
Dialog: Yes, yes, he is. (to Phineas) Sorry, Phineas, he's new.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, welcome to the job. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, say, Carl, have you seen my parachute pants?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, they're very nice, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not what I meant.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I know, sir, I was making a joke.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, that's.... Of course. That's uh very funny.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Thank you, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, where are they?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'll go get them.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, you're... you're here. Ahem. The, uh, Tri-State Area is mired in gloom and we believe Doofenshmirtz is behind it. We thought he retired the Gloom-inator, so this one is a big question mark. I'm sure you'll know what to do, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, Carl, how are we doing on those pants?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Did you want the ones with the triangles or the imitation paint splatters?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Triangles. And make it snappy. (pauses) I got the urge to pop and lock.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let's hurry up so we don't miss our appointment.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: How's it going, girls?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you know, we're just over here helping and being all buildery and stuff.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Cool beans. I'll let you get back to it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, cool beans. Cool legumes. (accidentally hits a hammer on one of Stacy's fingers)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, we'll just finish this wall and then we'll still be able to make it to the... (lets go of a ply-board she was holding and then waves) Oh, hi, Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: He's so dreamy. See what I mean?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, don't touch the... Oh, get away from that, you bad, bad kitty! No, not the Erase-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not the Bigger-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Look what you did to the moon! It's huge! It's... Uh... It's... Uh... It's actually kinda pretty.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (while gesturing and waving his arms around) No, no. You don't think I did all this...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It wasn't me, I tell you. (points to Mr. Fluffy Pants) I-It-It was Mr. Fluffy Pants.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I call him Mr. Fluffy Pants. You know, he's fluffy, he looks like he's got pants. Plus, he reminds me of my Uncle Fluffy Pants.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who never actually wore any pants. Come to think of it, I don't know why we called him that. Hmm. Anyway, I just love giving people nicknames. For instance, you're Mr. Duck-Bill Face. And Major Monogram, I call him "Monobrow". (laughs) That's a good one, you know, because he's... He's got the one, you know? And his little friend, the intern, is Dr. Coconut. (pauses) Yeah. Sometimes I wish I didn't know so much.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (unknowingly glues Stacy to the wall with gray wallpaper) Oh, Stacy, don't you just love how Jeremy buckles his tool belt on the third loop?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (muffled cries)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dreamily) Me, too. We're so gonna get married some day. Did I tell you what we're gonna name our kids? Xavier and Amanda.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (angrily rips herself out of the wallpaper) That's it! Our appointment's in five minutes, and I'm going with or without you.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, are you leaving? I was kind of hoping that maybe you could help me with a teensy-weesny little task. I need that slab of concrete turned into rubble by sundown. You don't mind, right? I mean... After all, it is for the less fortunate. Thanks, I knew I could count on you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I just finished my side of the house and I'm heading home. It was nice hanging out with you all day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye, Jeremy. It was nice hanging out with you, too. All day. (giggles) Did you hear that? We hung out all day.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (while causing a mess with the jackhammer) Ah, help me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm coming. Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Out of the way!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm sorry we had to clean up everything destroyed and had to rebuild it, I'm especially sorry I made us miss our spa appointment, but most of all, I'm sorry for being a bad friend. I was just trying to impress Jeremy and I lost sight of...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, you can stop that right now. You're starting to sound like one of those TV shows we like to make fun of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Stacy, I...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look, the way I see it, you prevented me from going to the spa, almost killed me with a jackhammer, dropped a wall on me, I've got gypsum in my hair, and basically wasted my whole day. But you did it for love, so it's okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, remember that time in the third grade?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean when you glued that hamster to my hair just to impress Billy Clark?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, it's like that.

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: (sigh) Billy Clark.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, I guess we're even.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: My...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gosh.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's not plugged in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, sis. Wow, you seem pretty wiped out. Looks like you two could use a spa day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A backyard spa? You guys are so bust...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, that sounds great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you two are our last customers. We're gonna go ahead and close up, but you're welcome to stay as long as you like.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, I keep telling you; it's not me, it's him. (points to the right) Look over there. Look.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? Stacy? What are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're enjoying the spa.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What spa?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, Phineas and Ferb... The spa's gone, isn't it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: What does that even mean?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Never mind.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? See, I told you it wasn't me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Mr. Fluffy Pants! (he grabs the cat just in the nick of time) Wait! Wait, wait, wait! Oh, that was close, Mr. Fluffy Pants. You almost... (screaming) You know, I think you're more trouble than you're worth.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, he seems okay. He seems so wovey-dovey.

Name: Boy
Dialog: My cat. I've been looking all over for him. (holds up a missing poster)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (after a long pause) Ah, I'm going to have to do the right thing here, aren't I? Fine. Here you go.

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Aw!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't you people have jobs?
